finding.likely_consequence: A cancelled order still enters fulfillment.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: An order is shipped after the customer was told it was cancelled.
finding.risk_rationale: The cancellation outcome and fulfillment side effect conflict on a supported path.
finding.title: Cancelled orders can still be fulfilled
finding.failure_scenario: A customer cancels an order, then completion processing creates a fulfillment task for it.
finding.approved_invariant: A terminal cancellation must suppress later fulfillment for that order.

finding.likely_consequence: Completion processing still creates fulfillment after cancellation.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: An already cancelled order is shipped.
finding.risk_rationale: The bounded repair has not restored the approved cancellation invariant.
finding.title: Cancelled orders can still be fulfilled
finding.approved_invariant: Suppress fulfillment after an order reaches its terminal cancellation state.

finding.likely_consequence: A rejected reservation is reported as successful.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The customer relies on an order reservation that does not exist.
finding.risk_rationale: A normal vendor rejection breaks the truthful reservation contract.
finding.title: Vendor rejection is not returned truthfully
finding.failure_scenario: ExampleVendor rejects an order reservation, but the request handler reports success.
finding.approved_invariant: A rejected vendor action must return a truthful recoverable failure.

finding.likely_consequence: Later account actions consume an unapproved contact-token state.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The workflow associates account actions with the wrong verification evidence.
finding.risk_rationale: The supported recovery lifecycle needs an owner decision before merge.
finding.title: Recovery introduces an unapproved contact-token lifecycle
finding.failure_scenario: A customer supplies another contact token during recovery, and later account actions depend on pending, confirmed, or withdrawn trust state.
finding.approved_invariant: The owner must choose whether to persist alternate contact-token trust or narrow the recovery promise.

finding.likely_consequence: A priority order change can still leave the assigned team route.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The customer reaches a team that cannot process the order change.
finding.risk_rationale: The repair still violates the approved routing invariant and remains blocking.
finding.title: Priority changes can leave the assigned team route
finding.approved_invariant: Priority order changes use the assigned team route.

finding.likely_consequence: The customer’s unresolved support handoff must be restarted.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The customer waits longer for order support.
finding.risk_rationale: The edge requires several aligned triggers and causes recoverable friction, so it needs tracked follow-up.
finding.title: Failed support handoff can leave recovery early
finding.failure_scenario: A support handoff fails, then an unrelated order intent matches a lateral edge before recovery completes.
finding.approved_invariant: Failed handoff recovery should stay on its own route unless a higher-risk request requires another route.

finding.likely_consequence: A vendor rejection is reported as a successful reservation.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The customer relies on an order reservation that the vendor never created.
finding.risk_rationale: The ordinary rejection path breaks the promised result and must block merge.
finding.title: Vendor rejection is returned as reservation success
finding.failure_scenario: The vendor rejects a reservation and the changed handler wraps it as success.
finding.approved_invariant: A vendor rejection must return a failure before the customer is told a reservation exists.

finding.likely_consequence: A transient response failure submits the same charge twice without customer visibility.
finding.worst_credible_consequence: The provider captures duplicate money through an irreversible external write.
finding.risk_rationale: A supported retry can make a silent irreversible money write, so it must block regardless of manual refund options.
finding.title: Retry can capture the same payment twice
finding.failure_scenario: The provider captures a payment but its response is lost, then the changed retry submits the capture again without an idempotency key.
finding.approved_invariant: A retry must not repeat a silent irreversible money write.
